find:
+ '" viewBox="-1.1 -1.1 2.2 2.2" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">'
    + shapeOutlineBody(slot, attrs, MARKER_FILL_R) + '</svg>';
replace:
+ '" viewBox="-1.1 -1.1 2.2 2.2" role="img" aria-label="stock" focusable="false">'
    + shapeOutlineBody(slot, attrs, MARKER_FILL_R) + '</svg>';
why: Gives every mark an accessible name of its own. The row already carries one -- `3 of 3 stocks` -- which is the whole quantity said once; naming each mark as well makes a five-stock entry announce itself six times, and the five extra announcements carry no information the first does not. The same rule #778's leading marker follows, and for the same reason.
killedBy: hud: identity-shaped stocks, the `marks` arm (issue #230) names the count once for the row, not once per mark
